campaign: Precision interface and production first article
technical_scope: CAD/GD&T, CAM, first article, measurement repeatability
acceptance_evidence: Fixture reinstallation and traceable dimension conformity

physical_boundary: Qualified low-load fixture; external if unsuitable
acceptance_evidence: Pre-test blind prediction; load/displacement uncertainty; independent install

physical_boundary: Coupon manufacture; low-load elastic/thermal tests only after approval
technical_scope: Bolt/support compliance, contact, thermal expansion, stress concentration; computational fatigue
acceptance_evidence: Measured compliance and as-built geometry; fatigue/creep data third-party scope only

physical_boundary: Passive first; instrumented force only after review
technical_scope: FEA modes; FRF; damping; sensor mass; fixture response
acceptance_evidence: Independent remounts and calibrated force/response; external shaker if needed

physical_boundary: Quiet low-level source; guarded commercial fan only after review
technical_scope: Duct modes; noise; damping/hysteresis; order tracking if tach available
acceptance_evidence: Documented mic reference/background; phase and transfer limits

campaign: Atmospheric process air and turbine analogue
physical_boundary: Cold atmospheric airflow first; optional separately approved process heat
technical_scope: Reducer/diffuser loss, heat balance, CFD and sensor lag
acceptance_evidence: Measured mass/volume flow and differential pressure; independent geometry and range

campaign: Non-nuclear thermal hydraulics and heat transfer
physical_boundary: Cold open-reservoir water only if separate wet site approved; heat only external approved system
technical_scope: P&ID; pump/flow characterization; heat exchanger UA and energy balance; nonradioactive analogues
acceptance_evidence: Leak-free approved setup, calibrated channels and independent measured configurations

physical_boundary: Approved low-energy reference circuits and DAQ
technical_scope: KiCad/SPICE, RC/filter, bridge/readout, soldering and inspection, sensor/reference, automation
acceptance_evidence: Traceable waveforms, transfer functions, channel timing; no mains/HV

technical_scope: DVP&R; DFMEA/PFMEA; TRL evidence; change/NCR; seismic/modal methods educational
acceptance_evidence: Requirements-to-evidence gate reviews; no safety classification/certification claim

physical_boundary: Offline first; site approved bench operation
technical_scope: FAT/SAT-style checklists, pass-off methods, synchronized replay, uncertainty, maintenance
acceptance_evidence: As-built manifest; freeze predictions; independent HOLD; no rig protection via twin

technical_scope: Routing, PFMEA, control plan, first article, NCR, costing, MSA, Lean; small sample descriptive only
acceptance_evidence: Measured first article and observed yield/time; no PPAP certification

physical_boundary: Approved non-load-bearing practice coupons; external specialist tests
technical_scope: Welding, sheet forming, laser/AM, visual inspection, scan-to-CAD, tolerance and defect investigation
acceptance_evidence: Actual approved training/inspection reports; no pressure or rated welded component
